page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top, page number at the top right, catchword and signature at the foot. No marginal notes; the marks along the left edge are show-through and are left out.

main_text.p: in[?] me maximam licentiam Hostibus meis permissi.

Tu qui olim Achitophelis consilia difflasti, & in bonum tui David, & exitium Authoris convertisti, ita & horum potes machinamenta subvertere qui hæc mea secreta evulgando, odio me volebant & contemptui Populi exponere. Tuam Omniscientiam appello Testem Integritas-tis mea, quam iniqua & falsa sint illa valdè probrosa, quæ hac Chartarum mearum occasione Hostes mei pessimi interpretes de me vulgo credi postularunt.
Malum quod in Me machinati sunt, & sollicitè ita procurarunt, ita in Caput Ipsorum revertatur, ut induantur pudore, & operiantur sicut diploide, confusione sua.
Vides Domine, quàm id omni studio agunt, ut Honorem meum deturpent, sensa animi detorqueant, & vestigia exprobrent Unctii Tui.
Me verò Corde illo dinè[?], quo libenter contumelias accipiam Tui causâ, & Tuæ Ecclesiæ.

Hunc in Me firma animum, ut tuo maximè studeam honori: meum tibi curæ fore nil dubito, vel me enim Potestati illi & Majestati restitues (quam nonnulli tuo permissu ita quærunt cripere) vel illa corona imperitiæ Christianæ patientiæ, tibi usque pertinacis per gloriam & ignominiam, per infamiam & bonam famam servire.
Tu (Domine) fons es Bonitatis & Honoris, tu eximia Majestate induëris: fac me tuæ Excellentiæ qua sapientia Iustitia & misericordia superas, aliquo saltem modo participem, nec jam illo

page.notes: The first word of the page, at the line start, is hard to read; it is read as "in" and marked [?]. "dinè" in "Corde illo dinè," is doubtful and marked [?]; it may be a different word. The show-through marks on the left edge were left out. Printed spellings such as "Unctii", "difflasti" and "sicut diploide" are copied as they appear. Hyphenated line breaks: "Integritas-tis" and "permi-ssi" are kept with their printed hyphens.
